_readme: Sourced court facts for city pages. The renderer ignores keys that start with _. A fact is included only when the cited page or OpenStreetMap element was retrieved and actually said it. Null dataset fields, OSM surface=other with no surface tag, and deleted OSM ways are listed under _omitted and are not rendered.

_omitted.why: No surface, lights, indoor/outdoor, or open-play value on these cities' publishable court rows was confirmed on a live OpenStreetMap element or a city/park page retrieved for this change. Garden Grove had surface=concrete on a row with no source_ref, and on OpenStreetMap way 1354311033, which now returns HTTP 410. Those surfaces were left out. Court counts already printed on the pages were not given a new writeup.

The courts dataset has indoor=false and lights=false. Live OpenStreetMap way 346937133 (the Beach & Tennis Club pitch) has no lit or indoor tag. Way 333435460 is building=commercial named Pickleball Haven and also has no lit or indoor tag. False was not published.

The courts dataset has indoor=true. OpenStreetMap way 83201240 does not. The City of Costa Mesa page lists pickleball on the open-gym schedule and, separately, rental of the Indoor Gym. It does not say the pickleball session is indoors or how many courts it uses, so indoor and a court count were not stated as city facts. The schedule was.

_omitted.why: Portola Park (way 1466666973), College Park (way 1472140216), North Lake Tennis Club (way 1306678787), and Galaxy View Park (way 1471513198) have no surface tag on the live OpenStreetMap way. surface=other was not published.
